messages:
Maya Chen (CSM): quick weekly tick — sharing p95/p99 latency split by route+model, streaming vs sync for Holloway Analytics. noticed a couple of spikes on Tues.
Devon Patel (SRE): putting raw numbers below. overall traffic +8% week over week.
Devon Patel (SRE): chat.completions (redwood-alpha-1): streaming p95=220ms, p99=520ms; sync p95=360ms, p99=900ms.
Devon Patel (SRE): embed.text (rw-embed-2): streaming not used, sync p95=45ms, p99=120ms.
Devon Patel (SRE): rerank (rw-rank-1): streaming p95=190ms, p99=470ms; sync p95=260ms, p99=610ms.
Maya Chen (CSM): TL;DR streaming gives lower p95 for chat but p99 still high on heavy tails.
Akira Sato (Customer): can you confirm if the p99 hit Monday evening is correlated with our batch job spawns? we saw user-facing lag.
Devon Patel (SRE): checking logs — there was a sustained 30% increase in concurrent sessions 18:10-18:40 UTC; queue depth rose, autoscaler reacted but with ~45s lag.
MonitoringBot: alert: high_queue_depth — service: chat.completions — peak_queue=78 — duration=1,800s — linked: https://telemetry.redwood.example/alert/3492
Liam O'Connor (Onboarding): onboarding cohort B is still routing some traffic to a canary model (rw-small-v1) which has lower throughput. that may contribute.
Devon Patel (SRE): good catch — rw-small-v1 p99 for sync = 1.4s under load. canary traffic was ~12% of their requests at that time.
Maya Chen (CSM): action items: 1) Devon to add sticky routing to avoid canary for live customers during business hours; 2) Liam to coordinate canary schedule with Holloway; 3) I will set up a quick enablement call for them to explain streaming benefits and fallback behavior.
Devon Patel (SRE): I can deploy a temporary routing rule today to cap canary to <5% during 14:00-02:00 UTC. will monitor p99 delta.
Akira Sato (Customer): thanks — if we can reduce p99 under 700ms for chat, our client demo next week should be fine.
Maya Chen (CSM): renewal note: usage dipped 9% in the trial workspace last month and we flagged a moderate renew risk. if we stabilize latency and run a 30-min enablement demo next Tue we may recover.
Liam O'Connor (Onboarding): I'll message the Holloway eng lead to confirm demo timing and ask for any specific flows they want tested.
Devon Patel (SRE): quick snippet of the command I ran to pull the p95/p99 splits if anyone wants to reproduce:
```
# gather 7d p95/p99 by route/model and mode
redwoodctl metrics query --start=1680000000 --end=1680600000 \
  --group-by="route,model,streaming_mode" --quantiles="0.95,0.99"
```
Maya Chen (CSM): cost/spend note: their monthly spend is up 5% YoY but CPUE cost per 1k tokens rose 12% due to inefficient canary use. we'll include that in renewal doc.
Akira Sato (Customer): appreciate the transparency. can we get a short report PDF after the routing change?
Maya Chen (CSM): yes — I'll push an updated p95/p99 snapshot + brief notes by EOD.
Devon Patel (SRE): monitoring follow-up: I'll set a synthetic heartbeat for the chat route at 30s cadence to better capture tail behavior.
MonitoringBot: note: synthetic_check scheduled for chat.completions — cadence=30s — start=2100000300
Maya Chen (CSM): thanks everyone. meeting if needed tomorrow AM — otherwise i'll post the updated snapshot here. :thumbsup:
Akira Sato (Customer): thanks team :pray:
Liam O'Connor (Onboarding): leaving an onboarding note: recommend we demo streaming with 3x concurrency to show p95 improvements.
Devon Patel (SRE): noted. will watch p99 and autoscaler thresholds during demo window.
Maya Chen (CSM): closing thread for now, will reopen if numbers don't improve after the routing tweak.
